test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically and definitely follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements :** Some Hats are Caps. Some Hats are Turbans. All Caps are Monkeys.

**Conclusions:** (I) Some Turbans are Caps.

(II) All Hats are Monkeys.

options.text: Both conclusions (I) and (II) do not follow.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a063c85c170146e66631cd2e78a245bd5f49392e3bb66878f444a29f0e9051f.png] 

Conclusions: 

(I) Some Turbans are Caps → **Not follows** (Because this is possible but not definite).

(II) All Hats are Monkeys → **Not follows** (Because this is possible but not definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions (I) and (II) do not follow"**.
